items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: He had those Marrero boys, the bass player and the guitar man

ctx.x: He had those Marrero boys, the bass player and the guitar man, and man, they set a tempo and that was it. They really had a dance band. I didn't like the way the popular band played, but out there he really had a nice band. They used to play opposite the Tokyo guard at Trenchinas nightclub. And they were celebrated, and they were known all over. but as a man, as a person, he was a grand old man. I know him well. He used to come, he liked to fish.
What about his second trumpet? Did he have a second trumpet out there? No.
